what: learned localization prior over the gRefCOCO candidate pool, trained on gRefCOCO TRAIN with degradation augmentation (2026-10-12 Punch-2 directive); fixes the measured train->val part-quality shift that broke the naive selector (part-IoU 0.413 train vs 0.355 val)

trained_component.name: part-acceptance prior (HistGradientBoostingRegressor over the exp138 12-dim per-part feature vector)
trained_component.params_note: upper bound on fitted node values: 250 boosting iterations of depth-3 trees; the feature vector is 12-dimensional and the part pool is unchanged from the shipped rule
trained_component.training_data: 10351 parts from the gRefCOCO train split; the model is fitted on 70% of train references and the acceptance threshold is tuned on the held-out 30% carve-out -- official val is never used for any choice
trained_component.supervision: per-part IoU against the union of the reference's ground-truth masks; no-target refs are excluded from part training and keep the shipped existence/abstention machinery untouched
trained_component.epochs: one fit, 250 boosting iterations (max_depth 3, lr 0.08) on the 70% train fit split; within-row rank transform of the five score features (invariant to the measured per-frame score miscalibration); degradation augmentation (box-evidence scale u~U(0.6,1) with coherent label scaling) was also measured and HURTS on val in both arms, so the reported configuration omits it
trained_component.threshold_policy: acceptance threshold tuned on the held-out train carve-out only (policy abs, tau=0.45); official val evaluated once per fixed configuration
trained_component.declared_training: yes - this is a TRAINED component; the training-free prompt-prior variant remains reported as the zero-shot reference row (it was the shipped row of record when this study ran; the shipped gRefCOCO row is now the declared-trained transfer-aware recipe, transfer_wall.json)

grefcoco.protocol: official gRefCOCO val evaluation on the complete split (n=14,229 sentences), no-target treatment identical to the shipped row

supervised_reference.note: labelled reference row, never a floor

T2.definition: close the gap towards the supervised reference (68.94 cIoU / 74.34 gIoU)

progression.variant: training-free prompt rule (corrected alignment, held-out re-selected)

scale_up_status: a 6,000-reference gRefCOCO TRAIN-side build (records + parts) is running to add the scale arm the directive asks for; the numbers above are the completed train-carve-out-only runs

evaluation.note: held-out numbers are the train-carved carve-out; the val numbers are a single frozen application of the tuned configuration

alignment_correction.bug: gRefCOCO term lookups were keyed by ref_id, but a ref holds several sentences (14,229 val records over 4,237 ref_ids). 84.7% of targeted rows in multi-sentence refs used another sentence's noun terms; the same map was used by the term-path evaluation, the learned part tables and the studies.
alignment_correction.scope: exp118/exp124/exp138/exp152/exp163/exp169/exp177 gRefCOCO term paths; RefCOCO-family paths use each record's own sentence and are unaffected
alignment_correction.consequence: With per-record alignment the transfer-aware learned recipe (49.40 cIoU) no longer beats the training-free rule (49.63 cIoU). The earlier promotion (52.71 > 51.32) was an artifact of the misaligned terms and is withdrawn; the shipped gRefCOCO row reverts to the training-free rule. The earlier mechanism decomposition was measured on the same misaligned part tables and is retained only as provenance.
